data.name: Hariksha
data.long_meaning: Hariksha is a beautiful and unique name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words, 'Har' and 'Ksha'. Har represents the name of the God Vishnu, who is also known as Hari. Ksha means auspiciousness or prosperity. Thus, Hariksha can be interpreted as the embodiment of God Hari's blessings and good fortune.
